name: 5-DM-DOM
summary: 5-DM-DOM, also known as 5-O-desmethyl-DOM, 5-OH-DOM, or 5-hydroxy-2-methoxy-4-methylamphetamine (5-HMMP), is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to the DOx psychedelic DOM (2,5-dimethoxy-4-methylamphetamine; STP). It has been identified as an active metabolite of DOM in animals.

pharmacology.text: 5-DM-DOM shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors (Ki = 210 nM and 500 nM, respectively). Its affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor was about 1.75-fold lower than that of DOM. In another earlier study, the drug's affinity (Ki) was 200 nM for the serotonin 5-HT2 receptor, with this being about 2-fold lower than that of DOM.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: The properties and effects of 5-DM-DOM in humans have not been reported and are unknown.

fact.en: It is one of the compounds the body makes from DOM, the psychedelic Alexander Shulgin first made in 1963 that reached 1960s San Francisco under the name STP.
fact.zh: 它是身體由DOM代謝出來的化合物之一。DOM是Alexander Shulgin於1963年首次合成的迷幻藥，1960年代曾以「STP」之名流傳於舊金山。
fact.zhHans: 它是身体由DOM代谢出来的化合物之一。DOM是Alexander Shulgin于1963年首次合成的迷幻药，1960年代曾以「STP」之名流传于旧金山。
